c1_intro: The Golden Isle once sang. Now it only burns.
Its ruler, the Smoke King, feeds his fires with the forests of the mortal shore.
You were his finest hunter. Asura-born. Never questioned. Never failed.
Until the night he ordered you to burn a village while its children slept.
They took your armour and your name, and threw you into the Ash Pits to die.
But your mother taught you the old signs, the mantras. And maya runs in asura blood.
c2_intro: Above the pits, the smoke thins into mist.
This is the Mirror Marsh, where the Smoke King's sorcerers bend the light.
Here the ground lies. Stones float that are not there. Paths hide that are.
An old sign wakes in your blood: the eye that sees through maya.
Trust nothing you have not truly seen.
